sermons.title: Sermon 725 | A Message From God To His Church And People

scripture.verse: "O Lord, I have heard Your speech, and was afraid: O Lord, revive Your work in the midst of the years! In the midst of the years make it known; in wrath remember mercy."
"And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of My hand."

sermons.title: Sermon 727 | God Incarnate, The End Of Fear

scripture.verse: "And the angel said unto them, Fear not."
